title: Tableau Workbook Load Time p95
dataSources: Tableau logs (`tableau:httpd`, `tableau:vizportal`, `tableau:backgrounder`), REST API, and `workgroup` repository tables via DB Connect.
app: Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC; `workgroup` repository via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:httpd status=200
| eval dur_s=round(time_taken/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by workbook
| where p95_s>8
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile load time for each workbook in Tableau and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Tableau workbooks by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Tableau timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest workbooks with their owners.
visualization: Table of workbook by p95 load time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Tableau so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
